name: german-ev-shift
title: German EV shift: KBA new-car registrations by brand and drive type, with company figures
description: Data behind the dashboard (docs/index.html) and the memo. Built by scripts/build.js from the unchanged KBA statistics files in data/raw/; company figures are read from the reports listed in data/sources_fetch.tsv. Field descriptions here are the data dictionary; docs/data-dictionary.md is printed from this file by scripts/dictionary.js.

licenses.name: dl-de/by-2-0
licenses.title: KBA statistics: Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0 (source: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt, Flensburg; processed by the author)

sources.title: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt FZ10, FZ8, FZ28 (press releases: figures only, see SOURCES.md)
BMW Group, Mercedes-Benz Group and Porsche AG annual and interim reports (see SOURCES.md)

resources.name: brands
resources.description: Every brand-total row ("<BRAND> ZUSAMMEN") of every monthly KBA FZ10 file, January 2021 to the latest month, plus the market total (brand MARKET). One row per month and brand. Owner groups (VW Group, BMW Group, ...) are built from these rows by scripts/groups.js, not stored.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Calendar month the registrations were made in, YYYY-MM.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand as KBA names it (upper case, e.g. VW, MERCEDES, MG ROEWE); MARKET is the KBA total of all brands ("NEUZULASSUNGEN INSGESAMT"); SONSTIGE is KBA's "other brands".

fields.name: registrations
fields.description: New passenger-car registrations in the month.

fields.name: bev
fields.description: Of which battery-electric (KBA column "mit Elektroantrieb (BEV)").

fields.name: phev
fields.description: Of which plug-in hybrid (KBA column "Plug-in-Hybridantrieb").

fields.name: diesel
fields.description: Of which diesel (KBA column "mit Dieselantrieb").

fields.name: ytd_registrations
fields.description: New registrations from January to this month of the same year. Empty where KBA marks the cell as a gap ("/", "X" or ".").

fields.name: ytd_bev
fields.description: Battery-electric, January to this month. Empty where KBA marks the cell as a gap ("/", "X" or ".").

fields.name: ytd_phev
fields.description: Plug-in hybrid, January to this month. Empty where KBA marks the cell as a gap ("/", "X" or ".").

fields.name: ytd_diesel
fields.description: Diesel, January to this month. Empty where KBA marks the cell as a gap ("/", "X" or ".").

resources.name: keepers
resources.description: New registrations by keeper group and brand, January to the file's month, from KBA FZ8 table 8.9.1 (all drive types; KBA publishes no split by keeper and drive type per brand). total = private + commercial + unknown; commercial = dealer + manufacturer + rental + other_services + other_commercial.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Last month of the January-to-month period, YYYY-MM.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand as in brands.csv; MARKET is "INSGESAMT".

fields.name: total
fields.description: All new registrations, January to month.

fields.name: private
fields.description: Registered to private keepers.

fields.name: commercial
fields.description: Registered to commercial keepers (sum of the five groups that follow).

fields.name: dealer
fields.description: Registered to motor-vehicle dealers ("Kfz-Handel"), self-registrations by dealers.

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.description: Registered to vehicle makers ("Kfz-Hersteller"), self-registrations by makers.

fields.name: rental
fields.description: Registered to car-rental firms.

fields.name: other_services
fields.description: Other service firms.

fields.name: other_commercial
fields.description: Other commercial keepers.

fields.name: unknown
fields.description: Keeper group not known.

resources.name: keepers_bev
resources.description: Market-level new registrations by keeper group, all cars and battery-electric, January to the file's month, from KBA FZ28.3.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Last month of the January-to-month period, YYYY-MM.

fields.name: keeper_group
fields.description: total, private, commercial, dealer, manufacturer, rental or unknown.

fields.name: all
fields.description: All new cars in the group.

fields.name: bev
fields.description: Of which battery-electric.

resources.name: ir_figures
resources.description: Company figures read from the BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche reports, one per row, each with the report and page. data/ir_evidence.tsv holds the text each value was read from; validate.js re-reads it from the extracted report text.

fields.name: company
fields.description: BMW (BMW Group), MERCEDES (Mercedes-Benz Group) or PORSCHE (Porsche AG).

fields.name: period
fields.description: Financial year (YYYY) or half year (H1-YYYY).

fields.name: metric
fields.description: Short metric key, e.g. auto_margin (Automotive/Cars segment EBIT margin), global_bev_deliveries, ev_impairment.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The figure as the report prints it, in the unit of the next column.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: % , pp (percentage points), cars, EUR m or EUR bn.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The metric in words.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Local path of the report (fetched by scripts/fetch-sources.js; URL and SHA-256 in data/sources_fetch.tsv).

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page of the PDF the value is printed on (1-based PDF page, not the printed folio).

resources.name: ir_evidence
resources.description: For every row of ir_figures.csv: the text fragment on the page that contains the value, and which position in it the value takes.

fields.name: company
fields.description: As in ir_figures.csv.

fields.name: period
fields.description: As in ir_figures.csv.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: As in ir_figures.csv.

fields.name: pos
fields.description: Position of the value among the numbers in the fragment (1 = first).

fields.name: fragment
fields.description: Text as extracted from the page (whitespace collapsed).

fields.name: column_order
fields.description: The column headers the fragment's numbers follow, as the page prints them.

resources.name: published_totals
resources.description: Totals that KBA prints in its press releases, with the line each is printed in; validate.js reads each from the fetched release with the pattern, checks the recorded number and line, and compares the number with the totals built from FZ10.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What the total is.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Year (YYYY) or month (YYYY-MM).

fields.name: brand
fields.description: MARKET or a brand as in brands.csv.

fields.name: field
fields.description: Column of brands.csv the total is compared with.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Local copy of the press release, fetched into data/cache/press/ by scripts/fetch-sources.js (not in git; URL in data/sources_fetch.tsv and SOURCES.md).

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Regular expression; its first group is the total as printed (German thousands separators).

fields.name: published
fields.description: The total as KBA prints it (thousands separators removed).

fields.name: source_line
fields.description: The text of the release the pattern matches, as printed (German number format); the recorded total is read from it.

resources.name: facts
resources.description: Dates and policy facts the page states (bonus dates, KBA press figures, company statements), each with the source text it was taken from; validate.js finds the source text in the cached source.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Name the page uses for the fact.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The fact as the page prints it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Local path of the source page or report.

fields.name: source_text
fields.description: Exact text in the source that states the fact.

resources.name: sources_fetch
resources.description: Company reports and policy pages that are not redistributed: where scripts/fetch-sources.js downloads each and the SHA-256 the download must match.

fields.name: local_file
fields.description: Path under data/cache/ (ignored by git).

fields.name: url
fields.description: Download URL.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 the download must match; - for web pages that change with every load (no pinned hash; their quoted text is checked instead).

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Expected size in bytes; - where not pinned.

resources.name: context_figures
resources.description: Figures from outside the KBA data that the page states: VW Group's own Western European BEV market share and ACEA's EU and German BEV growth (EU anchor), fleet CO2 against EU targets, and the lowest German list price of an electric model per group. validate.js finds each quote on its cited page and the value inside the quote.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Name the page and the claim checker use (ctx(key)).

fields.name: value
fields.description: The figure as a plain number (no thousands separator).

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit and basis, e.g. g CO2/km, % growth against Jan–Aug 2025, EUR incl. VAT.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Period or date the figure refers to.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What the figure is.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Local path of the cached source; #n is the PDF page (1-based PDF page, not the printed folio).

fields.name: quote
fields.description: Text on that page that contains the value (whitespace and HTML tags ignored when compared).

resources.name: memo_claims
resources.description: Claim list for memo.md: each row finds one number or statement with a regular expression and recomputes it from the data; scripts/check-memo-numbers.js fails if any differs.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Short name of the claim.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Regular expression; its first group is the number as written in the document (no group: the sentence must be present).

fields.name: formula
fields.description: JavaScript expression over the helper functions in check-memo-numbers.js; returns the expected text, or an empty string when a statement-only claim holds.

resources.name: readme_claims
resources.description: Claim list for README.md: each row finds one number or statement with a regular expression and recomputes it from the data; scripts/check-memo-numbers.js fails if any differs.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Short name of the claim.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Regular expression; its first group is the number as written in the document (no group: the sentence must be present).

fields.name: formula
fields.description: JavaScript expression over the helper functions in check-memo-numbers.js; returns the expected text, or an empty string when a statement-only claim holds.

resources.name: memo_de_claims
resources.description: Claim list for memo.de.md (German translation; same formulas as memo_claims.tsv, patterns in German number format): each row finds one number or statement with a regular expression and recomputes it from the data; scripts/check-memo-numbers.js fails if any differs.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Short name of the claim.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Regular expression; its first group is the number as written in the document (no group: the sentence must be present).

fields.name: formula
fields.description: JavaScript expression over the helper functions in check-memo-numbers.js; returns the expected text, or an empty string when a statement-only claim holds.
